paragraphs: Integrated Structural Analysis and Design Software for Engineers

PROKON is a powerful and versatile suite of structural analysis and design software widely used by structural engineers globally. It provides a comprehensive set of modules for the analysis, design, and detailing of various structural elements and complete structures, all while adhering to a multitude of international design codes. PROKON streamlines the entire structural engineering workflow, from conceptual design to final documentation.

• Perform Comprehensive Structural Analysis: Conduct detailed analysis of various structural systems, including frame analysis, finite element analysis (FEA) for slabs and walls, and truss analysis. Accurately model and analyze complex geometries and loading conditions.
  • Design Concrete Elements with Confidence: Efficiently design reinforced concrete elements such as beams, columns, slabs (including flat slabs, ribbed slabs), and foundations (footings, rafts) according to relevant design codes. Generate rebar schedules and detailing drawings automatically.
  • Design Steel Structures and Connections: Perform the design of steel beams, columns, trusses, and various connection types. PROKON provides tools to check sections, optimize steel usage, and ensure compliance with international steel design specifications.
  • Automate Detailing and Documentation: Produce accurate and clear structural drawings, rebar schedules, and comprehensive calculation reports directly from the design modules. This significantly reduces manual drafting time and potential errors.
  • Ensure Compliance with International Codes: Design and check structures against a wide range of international building codes, including Eurocode, British Standards (BS), American Concrete Institute (ACI), South African National Standards (SANS), and more, ensuring projects meet local and global requirements.
  • Streamline Workflow with Integrated Modules: Benefit from a cohesive environment where various analysis and design modules work together seamlessly. Data can be transferred efficiently between modules, providing a consistent and productive workflow.
  • Enhance Reporting and Verification: Generate detailed, verifiable calculation reports that clearly show the design methodology, input data, and results, essential for project documentation and peer review.
